question: Lala Lajpat Rai was associated with the _________ since 1921.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Servants of the People Society.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Lala Lajpat Rai, one of the most prominent leaders of the **Indian independence movement, was associated with the Servants of the People Society (Lok Sevak Mandal) since 1921.**
 
• He founded the Servants of the People Society, a non-profit welfare organization,** in Lahore in 1921.**
 
• The society was **established with the objective of serving the society in a non-political, non-sectarian manner, with its primary focus being education.**
 
• Even after his death, the **Servants of the People Society continued to function, with branches in several parts of India, carrying out charitable and social service activities.**
